produced_by: harness.calibrate_v20 (Agent QQ -- nested-LOSO calibration on v20)
description: v20 (GG2 ROM-aware OpenCap-only learned L2) + ridge L3 + per-slot linear calibration (pred_cal = a * pred + b) fit on nested-LOSO pseudo-residuals and applied to outer LOSO predictions. Per-slot fallback to uncalibrated ridge if calibration fails to tighten LoA or regresses CCC by more than 0.05 (no-regression guarantee). Single camera, single DWPose stream at inference.
loso_discipline: L2 all-data (no LOSO at L2); L3 outer LOSO; calibration inner LOSO over training-only subjects

full_trial.feature_pool: 13 ROM-based features across all 5 metrics, computed across the full trial duration

event_anchored.feature_pool: 10 features anchored to detected DJ initial contact → pushoff window (typically 100-230ms)
event_anchored.event_detector: harness/dj_events.py (scipy peak-find on ankle vertical trajectory)

training_dataset.name: OpenCap LabValidation_withVideos (drop jumps)
training_dataset.citation: Uhlrich et al. 2023, PLOS Comp Bio 19(10): e1011462

bias_correction_metadata.estimator: LOSO per-fold mean(train_pred - train_obs), averaged across folds

blend_config.scope: OpenCap (RTMPose + DWPose) clips only; ASPset fall back to Couro-only

blend_metadata.selective_adoption_rationale: Only slot in v16 where view-aware blend Layer-3 retrain produced a clean Good-tier promotion (CCC 0.63 -> 0.74, LoA half-width 10.18 -> 9.16 deg). Agent U recommended selective adoption (REPORT.md).

corrected_slots.estimator: mean over LOSO folds of mean(train_pred - train_obs); each held-out subject is excluded from its own correction term
